upstream.read_mode: git show on public tracked files; upstream working tree unchanged

files.adaptation: Reimplemented exact AST class and populated argument-key closure, parser Command refusal without raw query logging, parser version pin, AST size/depth ceilings, authorized relation binding, duplicate output checks and exact parameter use. New DuckDB types, source operators, source-local shape validation and staging are independent Open WebQL code. No PostgreSQL authority/catalog/witness code was copied.

Reimplemented invariant tests for bound values absent from emitted SQL, illegal relational phases, set composition and saved input relations using fictional DuckDB fixtures. No holdout or private fixtures were read or copied.

staging.argument_alignment: explicit source ordinal identity, never implicit SQL row order
staging.cte_materialization: referenced CTEs only, preserving each CTE LIMIT and filter boundary

implemented_language: explicit source bindings and web table sources
grouping, HAVING, DISTINCT and set operations
ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG and LEAD
projected UNNEST, list and struct access
pure correlated EXISTS and scalar SQL subqueries
source-local semantic projections and top-level SEM_MATCH WHERE conjuncts
finite SEM_SCORE and collection-scoped SEM_NORM stage shapes
limitations: No general SQL optimizer or inference pushdown. Whole source-local eligible row population is evaluated before final LIMIT.
Recursive CTEs, arbitrary functions/readers/catalogs, table-form UNNEST, semantic OR/NOT/JOIN, aggregate/window semantic expressions and correlated external calls are refused.
Static output types are provisional; schema-only DuckDB validation and final worker schema are authoritative for deterministic expression types.
Fixture tests establish compiler/planner mechanics only, not provider quality, full lineage, actual sandbox qualification or hosted integration.
